data.text: “Luke, I appreciate your offer, but joining us shouldn’t mean going without income. I’d prefer 10 tons each: everyone earns $10,000, and the lake replenishes to 100 tons. I’ll commit to that if we all agree. If Emma prefers your opening plan, I’m willing to take 15, provided we agree now on a rotation that gives everyone an equal total share. Emma, what works for you?”
